definitions.free: Core product free; no paid product tier verified.
definitions.freemium: Ongoing free functionality/tier plus paid upgrades or add-on services.
definitions.paid: Core product normally requires payment; limited free trials do not count as a permanent free tier.

existing.name: ChatGPT
existing.evidence: Free plan alongside Go, Plus, Pro and business subscriptions.

existing.name: Claude
existing.evidence: Free plan for everyone alongside paid plans.

existing.evidence: Free access and paid Google AI upgrades; availability varies by region.

existing.evidence: Standard is free; higher limits through Google AI Plus, Pro, Ultra or qualifying paid plans.

existing.evidence: Official plan guide distinguishes Free, Pro and Max.

existing.name: Hugging Face
existing.evidence: Free community features and basic Spaces compute alongside PRO and paid compute.

existing.name: DeepL

existing.name: Notion

existing.evidence: Free Beginner plan and paid Pro/Business.

existing.name: Airtable
existing.evidence: Free plan and paid plans for higher capacity.

existing.name: Cursor

existing.name: Postman

existing.name: Replit

existing.name: Docker
existing.evidence: Docker Personal free; Pro/Team/Business paid. Desktop license eligibility restrictions apply.

existing.name: DeepSeekDSH
existing.evidence: Public independent community guides, not an official DeepSeek product. Homepage says model API credits are not included; no verified site pricing declaration.

existing.name: Random Animal Picker
existing.evidence: Animal picker/facts permanently free without account. AI artwork has only a 3-day trial then paid monthly/annual membership.

existing.name: Free AI Voice Generator
existing.evidence: Homepage confirms recurring free short preset previews, but paid memorial offering is planned/waitlisted; pricing endpoint could not be read. Do not claim an active paid plan.

existing.name: Video Script Extractor
existing.evidence: Free daily short-video allowance, paid recurring membership and one-time credit packs.

existing.name: AskPDF
existing.evidence: Homepage and pricing inaccessible in research fetch; preserve unknown, do not substitute unrelated askpdf.org.

paidCandidates.name: Jasper
paidCandidates.description: AI marketing content and brand workflows.
paidCandidates.evidence: Paid Pro subscription and custom Business plan; 7-day trial is not a permanent free tier.

paidCandidates.name: Motion
paidCandidates.description: AI task, calendar and project planning.
paidCandidates.evidence: Paid Pro AI and Business AI subscriptions per seat; free trial rather than a permanent free tier.

paidCandidates.name: Surfer
paidCandidates.description: Search/AI visibility tracking and content optimization.
paidCandidates.evidence: Core platform uses paid subscriptions. Separate free tools are not a free core-platform plan. Official 7-day trial expires into selected paid subscription.

paidCandidates.name: Midjourney
paidCandidates.evidence: All four plans are monthly/yearly subscriptions. Official trial page says no trial on website/Discord; limited niji mobile trial is separate.

paidCandidates.name: Tower
paidCandidates.description: Desktop Git client for macOS and Windows.
paidCandidates.evidence: Standard paid subscription with 30-day trial. FAQ explicitly says no free plan; eligible students, educators and nonprofits can apply for free licenses.
